sentenceSets.sentence: The graduating cohort included several students who would later become prominent figures in their fields.

answerChoices.reasoning: A class is the ordinary name for students taught together, but the sentence looks back at everyone who finished in the same year and traces where they ended up.
Faculty are the teachers, whereas the sentence describes students who graduated and went on to distinguish themselves.
A delegation is a group sent to represent others, while these students are simply those who completed their studies at the same time.
Alumni are graduates of an institution across all years, but the sentence points to the particular group that finished together.
A committee is appointed to do work, whereas this group is defined by graduating in the same year.
A seminar is a course rather than the whole body of students leaving together.
A syllabus is a document and cannot include students who became prominent.
A scholarship is an award, not a group of people who graduated at one time.
A campus is a place and cannot include people who later became prominent figures.
A certificate does not contain students.
A single talk is not a body of graduates.

sentenceSets.sentence: Researchers followed a cohort of two thousand infants born in the same month for thirty years.

answerChoices.reasoning: A sample is drawn to represent a wider population, but this group is defined by all having been born in one particular month and is then tracked as a unit.
A population is the whole body a study seeks to describe, whereas the two thousand here are a specific set followed together across three decades.
A generation spans a couple of decades of births, while the sentence narrows the group to a single month.
A control group exists to be compared against a treated one, but no intervention or comparison group appears in the sentence.
A census counts everyone at one moment rather than following the same individuals for thirty years.
A survey is an instrument for collecting answers, not a set of people born in one month.
A registry is a list of records, whereas the sentence describes the infants themselves being followed.
A trial tests an intervention, and none is mentioned in this long-term observation.
A proposition cannot consist of two thousand infants.
A tool is not a group of people who can be followed for decades.
A building is not what researchers followed for thirty years.

sentenceSets.sentence: He arrived with his usual cohort of advisers, none of whom had been invited.

answerChoices.reasoning: An entourage exists to attend on an important person, while the sentence emphasizes the fixed group of associates who turn up with him wherever he goes.
A retinue implies formal attendants in service, but these are advisers who accompany him as a matter of habit.
A coterie is an exclusive circle bound by shared taste or outlook, whereas the sentence describes the working group he brings to meetings.
An escort accompanies someone for protection or ceremony, while these are advisers whose presence at the meeting was unwanted.
An audience watches a performance, whereas these people came in with him.
Clients are those who buy a service, but advisers work for him rather than purchase from him.
A committee is formally constituted with a mandate, while this group is simply the one that always trails him.
A congregation gathers for worship, which does not fit uninvited advisers at a meeting.
He arrived with several people, so he was not alone.
A schedule cannot consist of advisers who were not invited.
A bill is not a group of people arriving at a meeting.
